0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks host the Cleveland Cavaliers in their sixth game of the season, sitting at 1-4 and fifth in the Central, three games back, after a loss in their most recent game, while Cleveland is 3-2 and second in the division, one game back. Cavaliers guard Meleek Thomas is day-to-day with a foot issue and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was on March 17, 2026, in Milwaukee, when the Bucks lost 123-116, part of a 2025-26 season series that Milwaukee lost 1-3.
